component.name: BB84.MPX1
component.summary: SysEx editor and librarian for the Lexicon MPX 1

description.p: BB84.MPX1 edits and backs up the Lexicon MPX 1 multi-effects processor (firmware V1.00 and V1.10) over MIDI System Exclusive. It is an independent project and is not affiliated with Lexicon.

ul.li: Learns the unit's parameters and edits them live
Librarian for all 250 program slots, with backup and restore
Program, system dump and virtual front-panel editors
Import and export of .syx files, and a built-in simulator to try it without a unit
